name: BWYS
recent: BWYS 近期完成以 RM94.48 million 收购雪兰莪瓜拉冷岳一幅工业地，并签署多项协议以调整彩色涂层项目及拟议合资的安排。公司同时宣布派发每股 0.05 sen 的首次中期股息，并出现公司秘书、主要管理人员及注册地址的变动。
notable: 全资子公司 BW Scaffold Industries 以 RM94,479,631.50 现金完成收购一幅位于雪兰莪瓜拉冷岳的永久工业地。
公司与合资伙伴签署补充协议及多项相关合约，以修订和简化彩色涂层项目及拟议合资的合约安排。
公司宣布 2025 财年首次单层中期股息每股 0.05 sen。
risks: 公司出现公司秘书及主要管理人员的变动。
拟议合资及彩色涂层项目的合约安排经过修订，涉及关联方交易。

news.title: BWYS upbeat on FY26 prospects amid capacity expansion

recent_en: BWYS recently completed the acquisition of an industrial land in Kuala Langat, Selangor for RM94.48 million, and entered into several agreements to revise the colour coating project and proposed joint venture arrangements. The company also declared a first interim dividend of 0.05 sen per share, alongside changes in company secretary, principal officer and registered address.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary BW Scaffold Industries completed the acquisition of a freehold industrial land in Kuala Langat, Selangor for RM94,479,631.50 in cash.
The company signed a supplemental letter and several related agreements with JV partners to revise and streamline contractual arrangements for the colour coating project and proposed joint venture.
The company declared a first single-tier interim dividend of 0.05 sen per share for FY2025.
risks_en: The company saw changes in company secretary and principal officer.
The contractual arrangements for the proposed joint venture and colour coating project were revised, involving related party transactions.
